sources.name: France Éducation international – Exemples d'épreuves du TCF

notes: Only TCF Canada. Never use TCF Québec, TCF IRN, TCF Tout Public, DELF or DALF rules.
The FEI sample-tests page covers all TCF versions and includes 'Maîtrise des structures de la langue', which is NOT part of TCF Canada.
Practice items in TCF Quest are original; official examples are format references only.

sections.name: Compréhension orale
item_patterns: image shown, four spoken statements, choose the one matching the image
spoken question, four spoken replies, choose the appropriate reply
short dialogue, spoken question, four written answers
longer monologue or interview, spoken question, four written answers

sections.name: Expression écrite

tasks.name: Message
tasks.summary: Message to one or more recipients whose status is given: describe, recount and/or explain.

tasks.name: Compte rendu d'expérience ou récit
tasks.summary: Article, letter or note for several recipients reporting an experience or a story, with comments, opinions or arguments toward a goal.

tasks.name: Comparaison de deux points de vue
tasks.summary: Text comparing two viewpoints on a social issue taken from two documents, then giving one's own opinion.

fail_conditions_a1_not_reached: a task not written with the required number of words
one or more tasks not done

sections.name: Expression orale
sections.mode: individual, face to face with an examiner

tasks.name: Entretien dirigé
tasks.summary: Show you can exchange with someone you don't know (the examiner).

tasks.name: Exercice en interaction
tasks.summary: Obtain information in an everyday situation; the roles of examiner and candidate are given in the instructions.

tasks.name: Expression d'un point de vue
tasks.summary: Speak spontaneously, continuously and convincingly in answer to a question chosen by the examiner.

administration.computer_based_available: all sections except Expression orale (face to face)
